title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East (Early Show) on 1970-02-13
taper: Thanks to Dwight Holmes for providing the cassette source
source: 5th gen aud casette from unknown source > WAV

ai_review.summary: A rough early audience tape – harsh and cloudy in sound, with an unremarkable performance that at least features a run of Black Peter.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers note the recording is far from pristine; one calls it "harsh & cloudy" while the other says it's not on par with better tapes. The show itself receives little praise beyond the presence of Black Peter, and the tape is incomplete, limiting its appeal for most listeners.

ai_rating.rationale: The performance offers little standout material and the audio quality is described as harsh and cloudy; with only two brief reviews, confidence is moderate.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Harsh and cloudy sound, not comparable to higher‑quality tapes, incomplete source.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure; the show is noted mainly for its incompleteness.
